## Description

Applies Graph Diffusion Convolutional Networks directly over Riemannian manifolds of Symmetric Positive Definite matrices to compute smooth, topologically robust covariance matrix estimators.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional portfolio optimization, noisy covariance matrix estimation, risk-parity allocation.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Risk-Parity Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, fundamental relational adjacency graphs.

## Caveats

Combines graph diffusion operations with non-Euclidean manifold logarithmic/exponential maps.
